example_sentences.english: On cold days, I wear two shirts, one over the other.

example_sentences.japanese: 箱を三つ重ねたら、猫がその上に座った。
example_sentences.english: When I stacked three boxes, the cat sat on top of them.

example_sentences.japanese: 財布を無くしたので、交番に届け出ました。
example_sentences.english: I lost my wallet, so I reported it at the police box.

example_sentences.japanese: 引っ越したら、新しい住所を市に届け出なければなりません。
example_sentences.english: When you move, you have to report your new address to the city.

example_sentences.japanese: 会社を休むときは、前の日に届け出てください。
example_sentences.english: If you're taking a day off work, please file notice the day before.

example_sentences.japanese: 手伝ってくれた友達に、感謝する気持ちを伝えました。
example_sentences.english: I told my friend how grateful I was for the help.

example_sentences.japanese: 父は、困ったときに助けてくれた人に感謝することを忘れない。
example_sentences.english: My father never forgets to thank the people who helped him when he was in trouble.

example_sentences.japanese: 今日はお客さんに感謝する日なので、コーヒーが安いです。
example_sentences.english: Today is customer appreciation day, so coffee is cheap.

example_sentences.japanese: 兄は壊れたラジオを修理するのが得意です。
example_sentences.english: My older brother is good at repairing broken radios.

example_sentences.japanese: 冷蔵庫が動かないので、明日修理する人が来ます。
example_sentences.english: The fridge isn't working, so someone is coming tomorrow to repair it.

example_sentences.japanese: 古い靴を修理する店が、駅の近くにあります。
example_sentences.english: There's a shop near the station that repairs old shoes.

example_sentences.japanese: 会議の場所が変わったことを、みんなに知らせるのを忘れた。
example_sentences.english: I forgot to tell everyone that the meeting place had changed.

example_sentences.japanese: 赤ちゃんが生まれたら、姉は電話で知らせると言っていた。
example_sentences.english: My older sister said she'd call to let us know when the baby is born.

example_sentences.japanese: 授業に遅れるときは、先生に知らせるほうがいいですよ。
example_sentences.english: If you're going to be late for class, you should let your teacher know.

example_sentences.japanese: 銀行の窓口で書類を提出しました。
example_sentences.english: I handed in the documents at the bank counter.

example_sentences.japanese: 名前を書いてから提出してください。
example_sentences.english: Please write your name before you hand it in.

example_sentences.japanese: テストを提出した後で、答えを一つ間違えたことが分かった。
example_sentences.english: After turning in the test, I realized I'd gotten one answer wrong.

example_sentences.japanese: 来月の日本語の試験に申し込みました。
example_sentences.english: I signed up for next month's Japanese exam.

example_sentences.japanese: 電話でも申し込むことができますよ。
example_sentences.english: You can apply by phone, too.

example_sentences.japanese: 早く申し込まなければ、席が無くなるかもしれません。
example_sentences.english: If you don't sign up soon, the seats might run out.

example_sentences.japanese: はじめまして、山田と申します。
example_sentences.english: Nice to meet you. My name is Yamada.

example_sentences.japanese: 母が「ありがとう」と申していました。
example_sentences.english: My mother asked me to tell you thank you.

example_sentences.japanese: 一つ意見を申してもいいですか。
example_sentences.english: May I offer one opinion?

example_sentences.japanese: 夕方、もう一度電話致します。
example_sentences.english: I'll call you once more this evening.

example_sentences.japanese: 料理は私が致しますので、テレビでも見ていてください。
example_sentences.english: I'll take care of the cooking, so why not watch some TV?

example_sentences.japanese: 飲み物はコーヒーに致します。
example_sentences.english: For my drink, I'll have coffee.

example_sentences.japanese: 明日の朝十時に、駅まで参ります。
example_sentences.english: I'll come to the station at ten tomorrow morning.

example_sentences.japanese: 電車が参ります。危ないですから、下がってください。
example_sentences.english: A train is arriving. It's dangerous, so please step back.

example_sentences.japanese: 母はすぐ参りますので、こちらの椅子に座ってください。
example_sentences.english: My mother will be right here, so please have a seat in this chair.

example_sentences.japanese: 来週の火曜日に、そちらへ伺ってもいいですか。
example_sentences.english: May I come and visit you next Tuesday?

example_sentences.japanese: そのお話は、会議の後でゆっくり伺います。
example_sentences.english: I'll hear about that properly after the meeting.

example_sentences.japanese: 駅員に道を伺ったら、親切に教えてくれました。
example_sentences.english: When I asked the station staff for directions, they explained kindly.

example_sentences.japanese: 昨日、お手紙を拝見しました。
example_sentences.english: I read your letter yesterday.

example_sentences.japanese: すみません、切符を拝見します。
example_sentences.english: Excuse me, may I see your ticket?

example_sentences.japanese: おじいさんの古い写真を拝見して、とても驚きました。
example_sentences.english: I was really surprised when I saw your grandfather's old photos.

example_sentences.japanese: 私の言葉を信じる人は、弟だけでした。
example_sentences.english: The only one who believed what I said was my little brother.

example_sentences.japanese: 母はいつも「自分の力を信じる」と言っています。
example_sentences.english: My mom always says, "Believe in your own strength."

example_sentences.japanese: 猫が冷蔵庫を開けた話は、誰も信じるはずがない。
example_sentences.english: There's no way anyone will believe the story about the cat opening the fridge.

example_sentences.japanese: 冬の朝、窓を開けたときに感じる冷たい風が好きです。
example_sentences.english: I love the cold air you feel when you open the window on a winter morning.

example_sentences.japanese: 新しい町に引っ越してから、少し寂しく感じる日が多い。
example_sentences.english: Since moving to a new town, I often have days when I feel a little lonely.

example_sentences.japanese: 試験の前は、一時間がとても短く感じる。
example_sentences.english: Right before an exam, an hour feels really short.

example_sentences.japanese: 先生がご覧になる前に、この絵を直しておきましょう。
example_sentences.english: Let's fix this drawing before the teacher sees it.

example_sentences.japanese: 右の窓からご覧になる海は、とてもきれいですよ。
example_sentences.english: The sea you'll see from the window on your right is really beautiful.

example_sentences.japanese: おばあさんは毎朝、庭の花をご覧になるのが好きです。
example_sentences.english: The old lady loves looking at the flowers in the garden every morning.

example_sentences.japanese: お茶とコーヒー、どちらを召し上がりますか。
example_sentences.english: Which would you like, tea or coffee?

example_sentences.japanese: 先生は昼ご飯に弁当を召し上がりました。
example_sentences.english: The teacher had a boxed lunch for lunch.

example_sentences.japanese: 熱いので、ゆっくり召し上がってください。
example_sentences.english: It's hot, so please take your time with it.

example_sentences.japanese: 来週、先生のご主人が日本にいらっしゃいます。
example_sentences.english: My teacher's husband is coming to Japan next week.

example_sentences.japanese: おばあさんは今、庭にいらっしゃいますよ。
example_sentences.english: Grandma is out in the garden right now.

example_sentences.japanese: どちらからいらっしゃいましたか。
example_sentences.english: Where have you come from?

example_sentences.japanese: すみません、もっとゆっくりおっしゃってください。
example_sentences.english: Sorry, could you say that a bit more slowly?

example_sentences.japanese: お名前は何とおっしゃいますか。
example_sentences.english: May I ask your name?

example_sentences.japanese: 奥さんは、この料理が一番おいしいとおっしゃいました。
example_sentences.english: His wife said this dish was the most delicious.

example_sentences.japanese: 週末は何をなさいますか。
example_sentences.english: What are you doing this weekend?

example_sentences.japanese: お父さんは日曜日も仕事をなさるんですか。
example_sentences.english: Does your father work on Sundays too?

example_sentences.japanese: 来月、ご家族と旅行をなさるそうですね。
example_sentences.english: I hear you're taking a trip with your family next month.

example_sentences.japanese: この近くに郵便局があるか、ご存じですか。
example_sentences.english: Do you know if there's a post office near here?

example_sentences.japanese: 駅員なら、バスの時間をご存じだと思います。
example_sentences.english: The station staff should know the bus times.

example_sentences.japanese: あの方は日本の歴史をよくご存じです。
example_sentences.english: That gentleman knows Japanese history very well.

example_sentences.japanese: 隣の方から野菜をたくさん頂きました。
example_sentences.english: Our neighbor gave us a whole lot of vegetables.

example_sentences.japanese: お水を少し頂いてもいいですか。
example_sentences.english: Could I have a little water?

example_sentences.japanese: 駅で親切な女性に地図を頂きました。
example_sentences.english: A kind woman at the station gave me a map.

example_sentences.japanese: お客さんにお茶を差し上げてください。
example_sentences.english: Please serve our guest some tea.

example_sentences.japanese: 旅館の方に、外国のお菓子を差し上げました。
example_sentences.english: I gave the staff at the inn some sweets from abroad.

example_sentences.japanese: この本、よかったら差し上げます。
example_sentences.english: If you'd like this book, it's yours.

example_sentences.japanese: 医者が新しい薬を下さいました。
example_sentences.english: The doctor gave me a new medicine.

example_sentences.japanese: 叔父が古いカメラを下さいました。
example_sentences.english: My uncle gave me his old camera.

example_sentences.japanese: 雨の中、迎えに来て下さって、本当に助かりました。
example_sentences.english: You came to pick me up in the rain, and it really saved me.

example_sentences.japanese: はい、承知しました。書類は明日の朝までに送ります。
example_sentences.english: Yes, understood. I'll send the documents by tomorrow morning.

example_sentences.japanese: 店員は「承知しました」と言って、すぐ席を準備した。
example_sentences.english: The clerk said "Certainly" and got a seat ready right away.

example_sentences.japanese: 値段が高いことは承知していますが、これを買います。
example_sentences.english: I'm well aware it's expensive, but I'll take this one.

example_sentences.japanese: 弟は英語が少し話せます。
example_sentences.english: My little brother can speak a bit of English.

example_sentences.japanese: 風邪で声が出ないので、今日はあまり話せません。
example_sentences.english: I've lost my voice to a cold, so I can't talk much today.

example_sentences.japanese: 犬と話せたら、楽しいでしょうね。
example_sentences.english: It would be fun if I could talk with my dog.

example_sentences.japanese: 妹はもうひらがなで自分の名前が書けます。
example_sentences.english: My little sister can already write her own name in hiragana.

example_sentences.japanese: このペンは古いですが、まだよく書けますよ。
example_sentences.english: This pen is old, but it still writes well.

example_sentences.japanese: チョークがないので、黒板に書けません。
example_sentences.english: There's no chalk, so I can't write on the blackboard.

example_sentences.japanese: この漢字、読めますか。
example_sentences.english: Can you read this kanji?

example_sentences.japanese: 眼鏡がなければ、祖父は新聞が読めません。
example_sentences.english: Without his glasses, my grandfather can't read the newspaper.

example_sentences.japanese: 部屋が暗くて、地図がよく読めません。
example_sentences.english: The room is dark, so I can't really read the map.

example_sentences.japanese: この店では現金しか使えません。
example_sentences.english: This shop only takes cash.

example_sentences.japanese: 父はパソコンが全然使えません。
example_sentences.english: My dad can't use a computer at all.

example_sentences.japanese: 冷蔵庫が壊れて使えないので、困っています。
example_sentences.english: The fridge broke and won't work, so I'm stuck.

example_sentences.japanese: 駅までは歩いて五分で行けます。
example_sentences.english: You can get to the station in five minutes on foot.

example_sentences.japanese: 明日は用事があるから、山には行けません。
example_sentences.english: I have something to do tomorrow, so I can't go to the mountains.

example_sentences.japanese: 自転車なら、あの公園まで行けるよ。
example_sentences.english: By bike, you can make it to that park.

example_sentences.japanese: 田中さんは来週の会議に来られますか。
example_sentences.english: Can Mr. Tanaka come to next week's meeting?

example_sentences.japanese: 雪が多くて、先生は学校に来られませんでした。
example_sentences.english: There was so much snow that the teacher couldn't make it to school.

example_sentences.japanese: 日曜日なら、うちに来られる？
example_sentences.english: Can you come over to my place on Sunday?

example_sentences.japanese: 息子は辛い料理が食べられません。
example_sentences.english: My son can't eat spicy food.

example_sentences.japanese: この花は食べられるんですか。
example_sentences.english: Wait, you can eat this flower?

example_sentences.japanese: お腹が痛くて、昼ご飯が半分しか食べられなかった。
example_sentences.english: My stomach hurt, so I could only eat half my lunch.

example_sentences.japanese: このお茶は熱すぎて、まだ飲めません。
example_sentences.english: This tea is too hot to drink yet.

example_sentences.japanese: 夫はお酒があまり飲めません。
example_sentences.english: My husband can't drink much alcohol.

example_sentences.japanese: この薬はご飯の前に飲めますか。
example_sentences.english: Can I take this medicine before meals?

example_sentences.japanese: このホテルの部屋から海が見られます。
example_sentences.english: You can see the sea from this hotel room.

example_sentences.japanese: 仕事が忙しくて、映画が見られなかった。
example_sentences.english: Work was so busy that I couldn't see the movie.

example_sentences.japanese: 夏の夜は、湖の上にたくさんの星が見られます。
example_sentences.english: On summer nights, you can see lots of stars over the lake.

example_sentences.japanese: この仕事は一人で出来ますか。
example_sentences.english: Can you handle this job on your own?

example_sentences.japanese: 図書館の中では電話が出来ません。
example_sentences.english: You can't make phone calls inside the library.

example_sentences.japanese: 姉は英語と日本語が出来ます。
example_sentences.english: My older sister can speak English and Japanese.

example_sentences.japanese: 犬は泳げますが、うちの猫は泳げません。
example_sentences.english: Dogs can swim, but our cat can't.

example_sentences.japanese: この川は浅いから、子供でも泳げます。
example_sentences.english: This river is shallow, so even kids can swim in it.

example_sentences.japanese: 娘は去年から泳げるようになりました。
example_sentences.english: My daughter learned to swim last year.

example_sentences.japanese: 足が痛くて、今日は走れません。
example_sentences.english: My leg hurts, so I can't run today.

example_sentences.japanese: 祖父は八十歳ですが、まだ速く走れます。
example_sentences.english: My grandfather is eighty, but he can still run fast.

example_sentences.japanese: この靴なら、雨の道でも走れるよ。
example_sentences.english: In these shoes, you can run even on a wet road.

example_sentences.japanese: 来月、外国に住んでいる姉に会えます。
example_sentences.english: Next month I get to see my sister who lives abroad.

example_sentences.japanese: 忙しくて、恋人に全然会えない。
example_sentences.english: I'm so busy I never get to see my partner.

example_sentences.japanese: 駅の出口で待っていれば、すぐ会えるでしょう。
example_sentences.english: If you wait at the station exit, you'll find each other right away.

example_sentences.japanese: 切手はコンビニでも買えますよ。
example_sentences.english: You can buy stamps at a convenience store too.

example_sentences.japanese: 千円で、弁当が二つ買えました。
example_sentences.english: I was able to buy two boxed lunches for a thousand yen.

example_sentences.japanese: 値段が高すぎて、あの時計は買えなかった。
example_sentences.english: That watch was way too expensive, so I couldn't buy it.

example_sentences.japanese: 妹は六歳で自転車に乗れるようになった。
example_sentences.english: My little sister learned to ride a bike at six.

example_sentences.japanese: 荷物が多くて、バスに乗れませんでした。
example_sentences.english: I had too much luggage to get on the bus.

example_sentences.japanese: この車は七人乗れます。
example_sentences.english: This car seats seven people.

example_sentences.japanese: 雨が強いので、子供を一人で学校に行かせたくない。
example_sentences.english: The rain is heavy, so I don't want to let my kid go to school alone.

example_sentences.japanese: 会社は来年、夫を外国の工場に行かせるそうです。
example_sentences.english: I hear the company is sending my husband to a factory abroad next year.

example_sentences.japanese: 気分が悪いなら、娘を病院に行かせましょう。
example_sentences.english: If she feels sick, let's send our daughter to the hospital.

example_sentences.japanese: 母は毎朝、弟に野菜を食べさせます。
example_sentences.english: Every morning, my mother makes my little brother eat vegetables.

example_sentences.japanese: 猫に人の食べ物を食べさせないでください。
example_sentences.english: Please don't feed the cat people food.

example_sentences.japanese: 赤ちゃんにスプーンでご飯を食べさせた。
example_sentences.english: I fed the baby rice with a spoon.

example_sentences.japanese: 先生は生徒に同じ問題を三回やらせた。
example_sentences.english: The teacher made the students do the same problem three times.

example_sentences.japanese: 難しい仕事ですが、新しい店員にやらせることにしました。
example_sentences.english: It's a hard job, but I've decided to let the new clerk do it.

example_sentences.japanese: 兄は自分の宿題をいつも僕にやらせる。
example_sentences.english: My big brother always makes me do his homework.

example_sentences.japanese: 銀行の窓口で一時間も待たされた。
example_sentences.english: I was kept waiting a whole hour at the bank counter.

example_sentences.japanese: 彼女は約束に遅れるから、私はよく待たされる。
example_sentences.english: She's always late for our plans, so I often end up waiting.

example_sentences.japanese: 雪で電車が止まって、寒い外で待たされた。
example_sentences.english: The snow stopped the trains, and we were left waiting out in the cold.

example_sentences.japanese: 夜遅く帰ったら、父に叱られた。
example_sentences.english: I got home late at night and got scolded by my dad.

example_sentences.japanese: 図書館で大きい声で話して、叱られました。
example_sentences.english: I talked loudly in the library and got told off.

example_sentences.japanese: 犬がテーブルの肉を食べて、叱られている。
example_sentences.english: The dog ate the meat off the table and is getting scolded.

example_sentences.japanese: 料理が上手だと、祖母に褒められた。
example_sentences.english: My grandmother praised me for being a good cook.

example_sentences.japanese: 褒められたら、誰でも嬉しいです。
example_sentences.english: Anyone is happy when they're praised.

example_sentences.japanese: 私の絵が美術の授業で褒められた。
example_sentences.english: My painting got praised in art class.

example_sentences.japanese: 電車の中で赤ちゃんに泣かれて、困りました。
example_sentences.english: A baby started crying right next to me on the train, and I didn't know what to do.

example_sentences.japanese: 妹に泣かれたので、お菓子を半分あげました。
example_sentences.english: My little sister burst into tears, so I gave her half my snacks.

example_sentences.japanese: 空港で母に泣かれて、少し恥ずかしかったです。
example_sentences.english: My mom cried at the airport, and I was a little embarrassed.

example_sentences.japanese: 図書館で声を殺して笑いました。
example_sentences.english: I laughed in the library, trying not to make a sound.

example_sentences.japanese: 部屋の蚊を殺すまで、寝ることができなかった。
example_sentences.english: I couldn't sleep until I'd killed the mosquito in my room.

example_sentences.japanese: 祖父は「動物を殺してはいけない」とよく言っていました。
example_sentences.english: My grandfather often said you must never kill animals.

example_sentences.japanese: 昨日見た映画では、最初に医者が殺されました。
example_sentences.english: In the movie I saw yesterday, the doctor is the first one killed.

example_sentences.japanese: 兄のカメラを壊したので、殺されるかもしれません。
example_sentences.english: I broke my brother's camera, so he might just kill me.

example_sentences.japanese: その男の人は殺されたと警官が言いました。
example_sentences.english: The police officer said the man had been killed.

example_sentences.japanese: 日曜日は雨だったので、どこにも出かけませんでした。
example_sentences.english: It rained on Sunday, so I didn't go out anywhere.

example_sentences.japanese: 祖母は毎朝、近くの公園へ出かけます。
example_sentences.english: Every morning my grandmother heads out to the park nearby.

example_sentences.japanese: 出かける前に、窓を閉めてください。
example_sentences.english: Please close the windows before you head out.

example_sentences.japanese: 台所の電気が暗くなったので、新しいのに取り替えました。
example_sentences.english: The kitchen light had gotten dim, so I replaced it with a new one.

example_sentences.japanese: このシャツは小さすぎたので、店で大きいのと取り替えてもらいました。

example_sentences.japanese: 駅で会った人と電話番号を交換した。
example_sentences.english: I swapped phone numbers with someone I met at the station.

example_sentences.japanese: 時計が壊れているので、新しいのと交換してください。
example_sentences.english: This watch is broken, so please exchange it for a new one.

example_sentences.japanese: 祖父は健康のために毎日一時間歩いています。
example_sentences.english: My grandfather walks for an hour every day for his health.

example_sentences.japanese: お酒を飲みすぎるのは健康に悪いですよ。
example_sentences.english: Drinking too much is bad for your health, you know.

example_sentences.japanese: 医者と自分の健康について話しました。
example_sentences.english: I talked with the doctor about my own health.

example_sentences.japanese: 冬の間に体重が増えてしまった。
example_sentences.english: I put on weight over the winter.

example_sentences.japanese: 医者によると、うちの猫は体重が重すぎるそうです。
example_sentences.english: According to the vet, our cat weighs too much.

example_sentences.japanese: 甘い物を食べなくなったら、体重が減りました。
example_sentences.english: Once I stopped eating sweets, my weight went down.

example_sentences.japanese: 弟は去年より身長が高くなりました。
example_sentences.english: My little brother is taller than he was last year.

example_sentences.japanese: この紙に名前と身長を書いてください。
example_sentences.english: Please write your name and height on this sheet.

example_sentences.japanese: 友人と身長が同じなので、よく服を借ります。
example_sentences.english: My friend and I are the same height, so I often borrow their clothes.

example_sentences.japanese: 熱があるので、今日は早く寝ます。
example_sentences.english: I have a fever, so I'm going to bed early tonight.

example_sentences.japanese: 赤ちゃんの熱が夜になっても下がらない。
example_sentences.english: The baby's fever still hasn't come down, even now that it's night.

example_sentences.japanese: パソコンが熱を持って、動かなくなった。
example_sentences.english: The computer got hot and stopped working.

example_sentences.japanese: 夜になると咳が止まらないんです。
example_sentences.english: Once night comes, my cough just won't stop.

example_sentences.japanese: 映画館で隣の人が何回も咳をしていた。
example_sentences.english: The person next to me at the cinema kept coughing.

example_sentences.japanese: 咳が出るときは、熱いお茶を飲むといいですよ。
example_sentences.english: When you have a cough, hot tea helps.

example_sentences.japanese: 雨に濡れて、風邪をひいてしまった。
example_sentences.english: I got caught in the rain and ended up catching a cold.

example_sentences.japanese: 風邪をひかないように、コートを着て出かけましょう。
example_sentences.english: Let's put our coats on before we go out so we don't catch a cold.

example_sentences.japanese: 娘が風邪をひいたので、会社を休みました。
example_sentences.english: My daughter caught a cold, so I took the day off work.

example_sentences.japanese: この病気の治療には時間がかかります。
example_sentences.english: Treating this illness takes time.

example_sentences.japanese: 医者の治療が良かったので、すぐ治りました。
example_sentences.english: The doctor's treatment was good, so I got better quickly.

example_sentences.japanese: 犬の治療に三万円も払いました。
example_sentences.english: I paid a whole thirty thousand yen for the dog's treatment.

example_sentences.japanese: 領収書がないと、返品することができません。
example_sentences.english: Without the receipt, you can't return the item.

example_sentences.japanese: 姉は買ったばかりのバッグを返品しました。
example_sentences.english: My sister returned the bag she had only just bought.

example_sentences.japanese: 間違えて注文した本を返品しました。
example_sentences.english: I returned a book I had ordered by mistake.
